name: ST NUCLEO-G474RE (Nucleo-64)
description: The motor-control / digital-power Nucleo: 170 MHz Cortex-M4F with HRTIM, 5 ADCs, op-amps, comparators and 3 FDCAN on a Nucleo-64 with ST-LINK and Arduino Uno V3 headers.
notes: FDCAN and USB FS pins (PA11/PA12) are on the headers, but the board has no CAN transceiver and no user USB connector.
Popular for BLDC/PMSM FOC with X-NUCLEO-IHM motor-driver shields.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
